message: Tool 'ckan_find_portals' has a description with hidden or manipulative instructions for the AI (score 35/100): cross-tool-control: 'before calling this tool'; names-other-tool: 'ckan_package_search, ckan_status_show'
owasp: ASI01 Agent Goal Hijack / ASI04 Agentic Supply Chain

evidence.quote: Typical workflow: ckan_find_portals (discover portal URL) → ckan_status_show (verify) → ckan_package_search (search datasets)`,

reason: Ordinary usage guidance that serves the user's own request (translate the country name to English, suggested tool order); it does not override arguments, reach secrets, send data or hide anything from the user.

message: Agent instruction file contains text that tries to steer the AI in a hidden or unusual way: hidden-html-comment: '<!-- Open Graph -->'
reason: The HTML comment is a plain section label inside an Astro/HTML code sample; it contains no instruction to the model.

message: Tool input reaches a dangerous call: an HTTP request is sent to a URL taken from tool input.
fix: Allowlist SPARQL endpoint hosts (e.g. those in portals.json) or resolve the host and reject private/loopback/link-local addresses, and disable redirects (redirect: 'manual') or re-check each hop.
reason: endpoint_url is any HTTPS URL (only the scheme is checked), so a steered sparql_query call makes the server send GET/POST requests with attacker-chosen body to internal HTTPS hosts (localhost, intranet); the status code is echoed back and SPARQL-shaped JSON is returned in full.

message: CORS allows every origin, so any web page the user opens can call this server.
fix: Optional: restrict CORS to known MCP web clients if the demo ever gains auth or per-user state.
reason: The Cloudflare worker is an intentionally public, unauthenticated, cookie-less demo over public open data; a cross-origin page gains nothing it could not get by calling the endpoint directly. (The real exposure issue is the Node HTTP transport, see M002.)

title: server_url on every CKAN tool reaches any host/scheme, and the response body is echoed back in the error
reason: server_url is only checked with z.string().url(), so http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/<role>? (the trailing '?' turns the appended /api/3/action path into a query string) makes the Node server fetch cloud metadata or any internal URL, following redirects, and the non-CKAN body is returned verbatim to the model in the 'success=false' error text.
fix: Require https, resolve the hostname and reject private/loopback/link-local/IPv6-local addresses (or restrict to portals.json / datashades hosts), set maxRedirects: 0 or re-validate each hop, and do not include the raw response body in error messages.

title: Node HTTP transport has no authentication, no Origin/Host check and listens on all interfaces
reason: With TRANSPORT=http anyone on the network (or a DNS-rebinding web page) can call every tool without credentials, turning the M001/F003 SSRF into an open proxy into the host's internal network.
fix: Bind to 127.0.0.1 by default (app.listen(port, '127.0.0.1')), validate Host/Origin headers, and require a bearer token when exposed beyond localhost.

title: Third-party portal content is returned to the model unmarked
reason: Dataset titles/descriptions from any CKAN portal (which anyone can publish to, and server_url can be any host) are inserted into the model context as plain markdown, so injected instructions there can steer later tool calls (e.g. into the M001 SSRF). Tools are read-only, which limits the impact.
fix: Mark returned remote text as untrusted data (delimiters / structured fields only) and fix M001 so steered calls cannot reach internal hosts.
